usedFor: Stripe holds the billing and HubSpot holds the relationship. When “New Customer Created” fires in Stripe, “Add Notes to Contact” leaves a note on the HubSpot contact, so sales sees that they became a paying customer.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Stripe, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new Stripe customer is the moment billing begins, and the action writes a dated note on the contact, so the history shows when they started paying.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or an email, so the Stripe customer must carry one. “Delete Contact” in HubSpot cancels subscriptions in the other direction, so it deserves care.
